text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, Chloe-senpai, what did you do during lunch break at St. Theresa's Fes?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえばクロエ先輩、
テレフェスんときの昼休みはどうしてたんです？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, well, what did I do... oh, right, what about you guys?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ？
あー、
いや、
どうしたっけなァー……
え、
あんたらは？

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Why are you answering a question with another question? Well, Chieru had lunch with Miiko-chan and the others, and it was a lively lunch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで質問に質問で返すんです？
まあ、
チエルは
ミィコさんたちと、
わちゃわちゃランチしましたけど。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: I was napping in the courtyard, using Rosetta's lap as a pillow. So, Chloe-kun, who were you hanging out with?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくは中庭で、
ロゼッタの膝を枕にわちゃわちゃ仮眠していたな。
で、
クロエ君は誰とわちゃわちゃしていたのだね？

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: We had family over, so we had a lively family lunch. We ate bento together and stuff like that. Yeah, well, it was pretty normal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちは、
だから、
家族来てたから？
合流してわちゃわちゃベントー食べたりとか、
そんな。
うん、
まあ、
全然フツーっすよ。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: You mean, it was normal for you to hesitate that much before calling it normal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
普通っていうわり、
随分と言い淀みましたね。

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: That's strange... was it really normal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
妙だな……
本当に普通だったのだろうか。

text_block_list.name: Chloe
text_block_list.text: Oh, right, I remember now. Come to think of it, {0} might have been there too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
そーだ、
思い出した。
そーいや、
なんか{0}も一緒だったかも。

text_block_list.name: Chieru
text_block_list.text: Huh? You forget that an unexpected guest joined your peaceful family gathering?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
和やかな一家団欒の日常に、
そんな突発ゲストが飛び入り参加したこと忘れます？

text_block_list.name: Yuni
text_block_list.text: And you call that normal... you're quite something, Chloe-kun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それを普通と呼ぶのか……
大概だぞクロエ君……
